flatten_tensors: flatten a list of numpy tensors into a single 1D array by reshaping and concatenating
unflatten_tensors: unflatten a 1D array back into a list of tensors given their original shapes
pad_tensor_n: pad a list of 1D arrays to a uniform max length with zeros for batched sequence data
stack_tensor_dict_list: stack a list of tensor dictionaries into a single dictionary of stacked tensors
split_tensor_dict_list: split a stacked tensor dictionary back into a list of per-sample dictionaries
